name: jbjornson
description: Josh Bjornson's fork of brianmd/mailmate — the MailMate mail toolkit for macOS, with local fixes for MailMate 2.0.

plugins.name: mailmate
plugins.description: Search, read, tag, archive, draft, and send mail through MailMate on macOS — MCP tools backed by the mailmate gem. Self-provisions an isolated Ruby runtime on first launch; requires macOS with MailMate installed.
